name: Starter mix: decoy or target?
engine: Pull their attention with the decoy, or pick on a rattled man: most decisions feed one of them, not both.
about: One piece or two from each family. Oyarzabal is the decoy and Fabián arrives late for the pass meant for a watched man (A). Once in the first half you may play an attack for show, and every attack after it has their defence stretched from its second decision (B; Guessing is on for both teams in every match). Run at him rattles a man a run or carry beats (a half win is enough), and captain Rodri turns one half win a possession against a rattled man into a clean win (C). On their attacks you sit deep (D).
decisions: Keep the ball away from Oyarzabal, or run at the man in front of you: the decoy wants passes, the target wants runs.
Spend the show attack early: every later attack is stretched.
Sitting deep makes your tackles -1: a rattled attacker is harder to punish on defence.
